patch_description: Remove the globally shared pre/post RZ rotations, which commute with the CZ network and add two parameters without providing wire-specific control. Retain the two parity-shared RY parameters and strengthen feature mixing with a parameter-free multiscale CZ graph: a periodic nearest-neighbor ring captures local structure, while four opposite-wire couplings propagate information across the full register. This reduces the distinct ansatz parameters from four to two, lowers the train-test overfitting opportunity, and adds long-range interactions aimed at improving worst-group separation.
